name: Bisi Bele Bath
ingredients: 1/2 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, beans, peas, potatoes)
2 tbsp Bisi Bele Bath powder (roasted coriander, chana dal, urad dal, dried red chilies, cinnamon, cloves, poppy seeds, grated coconut)
instructions: 1. Wash and pressure cook rice, dal, and vegetables together with 4 cups of water and turmeric until soft.
3. In a pan, mix the tamarind extract, cooked rice-dal mixture, salt, and Bisi Bele Bath powder; boil for 5-7 minutes.
4. Adjust consistency by adding warm water if it becomes too thick.
5. Prepare a tempering by heating ghee in a small pan, adding mustard seeds, cumin, curry leaves, hing, and cashews.
6. Pour the tempering over the rice mixture, mix well, and serve hot with a dollop of ghee and boondi or papad.
description: Bisi Bele Bath translates to 'hot lentil rice' in Kannada. It is a quintessential comfort food from Karnataka, known for its complex blend of spices and textures. It is traditionally served during special occasions, festivals, and as a staple breakfast or lunch in households across the state.
